note: Aa=image-left=+azimuth(CCW,left of forward). Cell az = camera-frame horizontal azimuth atan2(y_c,x_c). NAMING: every V1 sector letter X in {A,B,C,D,E} is bisected into Xa (the LEFT/higher-azimuth half) and Xb (the RIGHT/lower-azimuth half), so the V1 letter is still readable off the V2S name and the sector pair (Xa,Xb) is exactly V1 sector X. Sector width 6.22 deg = half of V1's 12.44 deg; every V1 edge survives (31.1/18.66/6.22/-6.22/-18.66/-31.1) and five new interior edges are added at 24.88/12.44/0.0/-12.44/-24.88. Cell id = sector name + band name, e.g. Aa1, Cb2, Db3a, Eb3b (2-char sector prefix, then the band name -- the trailing a/b of band 3a/3b is the BAND letter, the second char of the sector prefix is the SECTOR half).
nesting_note: V2S is a strict ANGULAR refinement of V1: the band edges, the outer radius (12 m) and the total angular coverage (+-31.1 deg) are byte-identical to gridspec_v1.json, and each V1 sector s is cut exactly in half into V2S sectors 2s (left half) and 2s+1 (right half). FOLDING LAW: V1_cell(b*5+s) == V2S_cell(b*10+2s) OR V2S_cell(b*10+2s+1) for every band b and V1 sector s. Because the set of ground points inside the grid is identical, every frame-level property that depends only on grid COVERAGE (any-cell-positive, therefore the none_in_fov tier, and the lip seed mask cell>=0, therefore edge_ratio and the V/E/H tier map) is invariant between V1 and V2S. hflip: the sector permutation has NO fixed centre sector at an even sector count -- it is the pairing (1<->10, 2<->9, ..., 5<->6) in 1-based terms, which is exactly what the generic gridspec.Grid.flip_perm formula band*ns+(ns-1-sector) produces; nothing may hard-code it.
